agent_claim: Fixed vanX.raw to unwrap only own state-backed fields via rawVal (no subscription), falling back to Reflect.get with raw proxy as receiver for array length/methods, class prototype methods, and symbols; added string-only ownKeys/getOwnPropertyDescriptor handling. Reproduction and public regressions pass in sandbox.
patch:
--- a/x/src/van-x.js
+++ b/x/src/van-x.js
@@ -62,8 +62,20 @@
 
 let stateFields = obj => obj[statesSym]
 
-let raw = obj => obj[statesSym] ?
-  new Proxy(obj[statesSym], {get: (obj, name) => raw(obj[name].rawVal)}) : obj
+let raw = obj => obj?.[statesSym] ?
+  new Proxy(obj[statesSym], {
+    get: (states, name, proxy) => {
+      let v = hasOwn(states, name) ? states[name] : _undefined
+      return v instanceof Object && "rawVal" in v ? raw(v.rawVal) : refGet(states, name, proxy)
+    },
+    ownKeys: states => refOwnKeys(states).filter(k => typeof k === "string"),
+    getOwnPropertyDescriptor: (states, name) => {
+      let v = hasOwn(states, name) ? states[name] : _undefined
+      return v instanceof Object && "rawVal" in v ?
+        {value: raw(v.rawVal), writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true} :
+        Reflect.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(states, name)
+    },
+  }) : obj
 
 let filterBindings = states =>
   states[bindingsSym] = states[bindingsSym].filter(b => b._containerDom.isConnected)
limitation: VERIFIED means the executed frozen/public/independent checks passed; not a proof of correctness.
